description:
A research librarian has noticed inconsistent author names in the library. Your task is to audit and standardize the names of three specific researchers: Alan Turing, Claude Shannon, and Geoffrey Hinton.

1. Locate 'On Computable Numbers...' and 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence'. Normalize the author to First Name: 'Alan M.', Last Name: 'Turing'.
2. Locate 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' and 'The Mathematical Theory of Communication'. Normalize the author to First Name: 'Claude E.', Last Name: 'Shannon'.
3. Locate 'ImageNet Classification...'. Normalize the author to First Name: 'Geoffrey E.', Last Name: 'Hinton'.

To edit an author: Click the item, then in the right-hand Info pane, click the author's name (First/Last fields). Ensure the names are identical across the specified papers.
